eyebrow.tone: welcoming dining framing (Reservations, Book a table, Come eat with us)

headline.tone: serif, warm — 'The table is ready.' Not 'Contact us.'

form_intro.tone: friendly, sets expectations — mention response time, walk-ins welcome if true

address.tone: street address + neighborhood identifier (e.g. 'corner of Vine & 3rd, Greenpoint')

hours_text.tone: dining hours, e.g. Tue–Sun, 5pm–10pm. Lunch Sat–Sun, 11am–3pm.

form_slug.tone: project slug injected by the compiler for form action URL
